I’m not aware of any official OpenAI‑compatible endpoint that Ollama exposes for streaming speech audio on macOS. Ollama’s public API (via `http://localhost:11434`) only offers the `/api/generate`, `/api/chat`, `/api/embeddings`, etc. endpoints for text, and it does not implement the OpenAI `/v1/audio/speech` TTS endpoint.

If you’ve seen a project that adds speech streaming, it would have to be a custom wrapper or extension that implements its own `/v1/audio/speech`‑style endpoint. As of now, no such endpoint exists in the standard Ollama distribution.
